title: primula elatior subsp. tatrensis
intro: Primula elatior subsp. tatrensis, commonly known as the high-altitude primrose or Tatranska primrose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Primula elatior subsp. tatrensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are believed to have antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential uses of this plant.
